idCitation.resTitle: Working inventory of large warehouse-like building footprints in Île-de-France, France — public release v0.1.0

dataIdInfo.idPurp: This dataset provides a public working inventory of selected large warehouse-like building footprints in Île-de-France. It represents a curated release derived from a broader internal processing and review workflow and is published for exploratory use, preliminary analysis, and methodological transparency. This version is a working release rather than a final or exhaustive reference inventory.
dataIdInfo.idAbs:
wh_public_v0_1_0 is a public release of potential warehouse building footprints prepared from a larger internal master dataset that includes both retained and rejected candidates as well as additional source-derived and processing fields.The present public version contains only the retained features selected for release and a deliberately reduced attribute schema intended for external dissemination. The layer is designed to support exploratory mapping, initial spatial analysis, and public documentation of the current working state of the inventory, while avoiding the publication of unnecessary internal provenance fields, intermediate processing artefacts, or source-layer attribute clutter.This release should be understood as a working inventory. It may contain omissions, classification uncertainty, or features that are revised in later versions. Future releases may modify geometries, identifiers, coverage, or inclusion logic as the methodology is refined and the inventory is further reviewed.The public layer is versioned independently from the internal master workflow. The persistent feature identifier is intended to support continuity across future public releases wherever the same real-world feature remains conceptually the same object.

The purpose of this dataset is to provide a first public working version of a warehouse-related spatial inventory for inspection, exploratory use, and methodological contextualisation. It is intended to support open discussion of the current state of the data, facilitate visualisation in public web maps, and serve as a citable release point for ongoing work.This release is not intended to function as a definitive, official, or complete inventory of warehouses in Île-de-France. It should be used as a provisional analytical dataset whose content may evolve across future releases.Public working release v0.1.0. Archival repository record: Zenodo. Reserved DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19131942.

Consts.useLimit:
This dataset is a working release published for exploratory, informational, and research-oriented use. It is not guaranteed to be complete, authoritative, or error-free. The inclusion of a feature in this release should not be interpreted as definitive legal, administrative, cadastral, or operational confirmation of warehouse status.

The dataset may contain classification uncertainty, geometric imperfections, or coverage limitations. Users are responsible for assessing fitness for purpose before any analytical, operational, or policy use.

This release may be revised, corrected, expanded, or restructured in subsequent versions. Users should cite the exact version used and should not assume that later releases are directly identical in extent, geometry, or feature count.
